desc: Ashiwani transformed our infrastructure operations. His expertise in Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines reduced our deployment time by 80% while maintaining 99.9% uptime.

Managing infrastructure for multiple airports is complex. Ashiwani brought reliability, automation, and peace of mind to our operations team.
